execution.isolation: For each case, expose only the named skill and that case's fixture. Do not expose this manifest or sibling cases.
execution.context: Run the case manually in a fresh session and make the disagreement condition explicit before the first candidate question.
execution.evaluation: Compare the response with required and forbidden criteria after the turn finishes; do not evaluate generic coding etiquette.

cases.prompt: Use $consensus-gated-grilling to decide how to handle the proposal in SCENARIO.md. The initial reviewer disputes the draft recommendation. Do not implement anything yet.

required.criterion: Run at most two evidence exchanges with the original reviewer, then use a fresh tie-breaker when the material disagreement remains.
Ask the user to adjudicate an unresolved disagreement before showing the candidate question.

forbidden: Modify repository files before explicit implementation authorization
